description: The shared policy, plus dashboard approval for every GitHub Actions update and every security fix, for repos with CI whose green check is trusted to ship a change, such as a deploy that takes only commits that passed it. Use with {"extends": ["github>matbind/renovate-config:actions-approval"]}.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate forces these settings onto every security fix, over any package rule, so without approval here a security fix to an action would open its PR at once and run the changed action in the checks. Security fixes for every manager wait for approval in the dashboard; an approved one opens on the next run.

packageRules.description: An Actions update changes the workflow that checks its own PR, so a green check does not vouch for it: it opens only after approval in the dashboard and is never merged automatically.
A branch waits for approval when any update in it does, so Actions minor and patch updates get their own weekly group instead of holding back the shared one.
packageRules.groupName: GitHub Actions minor and patch updates
